seen_film: A rough green sea seen from above with no horizon. Frames 1-2: dark, choppy water with fine streaks. Frames 3-4: the surface breaks up into white foam, with a whitecap at lower left. Frames 5-8: large white breaking crests move across the frame (one left-of-center, one lower-center moving right toward the lower right corner), and a long wave ridge forms across the upper half. Frames 9-12: one large wave builds and peaks at right-center with spray on its crest while the foam patches fade. Frames 13-14: the camera tilts up, a pale sky band and horizon appear at the top, and the crest is now small at right. Frames 15-16: the sea is calmer and flatter below the horizon, with a last small breaking crest at the right edge.
named_subject: Ocean waves (several wavy lines representing a sea surface).
evidence: Matches: frames 9-11 raise the top line's right end into a crest at the right, in step with the film's large wave peaking at right-center in 9-12; frames 13-16 curl and drop that crest as the film's crest shrinks and the sea flattens; the horizon line appears in frame 12 and the drawing shifts down, close to the film's tilt-up revealing the horizon in 13. Misses: in frames 3-8 the film shows the sea breaking into foam and white crests travelling across the frame, while the animation's lines stay almost identical (frames 1-4 nearly unchanged); the only activity there is the left zigzag spiking in 5 and collapsing in 6, and a bump that appears on the bottom line only in frame 8 and vanishes in 9, which read as pops rather than waves travelling. The middle and lower lines never move as waves through the whole shot.
primary_gap: The turbulent first half of the film (frames 3-8, crests breaking and travelling across the water) is performed as near-stillness plus isolated one-frame pops, so the sea does not look rough and moving until the right-end crest in frames 9-11.
closes_when: In frames 3-8 the existing wave lines carry visible crests that travel steadily left to right across successive frames (a peak on the bottom line moving from lower-center toward lower-right, a rise on the middle lines moving across), with no bump that appears in one frame and disappears in the next.
